name: people-picker
title: People picker
description: Picks people by name, with their faces and roles, the ones picked lately first, and search as you type.

props.name: people
props.description: Everyone who can be picked, in one list.

props.name: groups
props.description: Everyone who can be picked, in titled groups (teams, offices) instead of one list.

props.name: search
props.description: Searches on the app's side, in place of `people` and `groups`. Resolve to people, or to titled groups of them.

props.name: recent
props.description: People picked lately: listed first, under "Recent", while the query is empty.

props.name: maxChips
props.description: With `multiple`: chips shown before the rest fold into a "+N" chip. All of them by default.
